title: Bodycon Cutout 솔로 #049 · super hourglass · 가슴 아래 가로 밴드 파임 · nylon · 힙 팝 · 런웨이 · 웨이쉰
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm bronze-brown complexion, mid 30s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, waist-length braids lavender hair — wearing a skin-tight micro bodycon mini dress of opaque matte black 40-denier nylon with thin shoulder straps, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to just under her bust, the two sides of the nylon fully covering her bust, a wide horizontal band cut away across her ribs and stomach from just under her bust down to below her navel, the whole band bare, with two thin vertical straps of the nylon at the sides joining the bust section to the skirt, a plain ultra-high slit cut up the left side of the dress from the hem to her hip bone, the slit baring her whole left thigh and the side of her left hip, the hem ending just below her hip bones, a micro length hardly longer than a belt, her arms and legs bare, the nylon shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, very fine pale hair on her forearms catching the light and a small mole near her collarbone. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin nylon molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the two thin side straps holding the bust section above the open band, the dress stretched taut over the curve of her hips and glutes, the open slit falling in a clean line, fine stretch lines and a soft matte sheen. Pose: strong hip pop left, both hands pressing outer hips outward arching back to extreme — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, knee-high lace-up platform stiletto boots made of glossy black leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, in glossy black lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts, a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, and sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: a warm rose-red wash blended across the outer corners of both eyes and drifting up toward the temples, the same flush spreading softly across the cheekbones and the bridge of the nose, slightly smudged, dewy highlights, soft brown-pink eyeshadow, large moist eyes with bright real catchlights and a faint glassy shine, moist rose-tinted lips.

Background: a long white fashion-show runway with a glossy white floor, standard-height steps at the end and softly lit empty rows of seats, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
